#include #include #include #include #include #include #include #include using namespace std; class G { public: class Problem; void begin() { Problem problem; problem.run(1, cin, cout); } class Problem { public: class MinCostFlow { private: struct Edge { int to, cap, rev, cost; Edge(int t, int c, int w, int r) : to(t), cap(c), cost(w), rev(r) {} }; vector> adj; vector> edgeMatrix; vector potential; int N, source, sink, flow; long long totalCost; const int INF = INT_MAX / 2; vector prevNode, prevEdge, visited, distArray; vector queueBuffer; public: MinCostFlow(int nodes, int s, int t) { N = nodes; source = s; sink = t; flow = 0; totalCost = 0; adj.resize(N); potential.resize(N, 0); } void addEdge(int u, int v, int capacity, int weight) { Edge forward = Edge(v, capacity, weight, adj[v].size()); Edge backward = Edge(u, 0, -weight, adj[u].size()); adj[u].push_back(forward); adj[v].push_back(backward); } void packEdges() { edgeMatrix.resize(N); for(int i = 0; i < N; i++) { edgeMatrix[i] = adj[i]; adj[i].clear(); } } void initializePotential() { fill(potential.begin(), potential.end(), INF); potential[source] = 0; bool changed = true; for(int iter = 0; iter < N && changed; iter++) { changed = false; for(int u = 0; u < N; u++) { if(potential[u] == INF) continue; for(const Edge& e : edgeMatrix[u]) { if(e.cap > 0 && potential[u] + e.cost < potential[e.to]) { potential[e.to] = potential[u] + e.cost; changed = true; } } } } } bool performSPFA() { distArray.resize(N); prevNode.resize(N); prevEdge.resize(N); visited.resize(N, 0); queueBuffer.resize(N); fill(distArray.begin(), distArray.end(), INF); distArray[source] = 0; int head = 0, tail = 0; queueBuffer[tail++] = source; while(head != tail) { int u = queueBuffer[head++]; if(head == N) head = 0; visited[u] = 2; for(int idx = 0; idx < edgeMatrix[u].size(); idx++) { Edge& e = edgeMatrix[u][idx]; if(e.cap == 0) continue; int nd = distArray[u] + e.cost; if(nd < distArray[e.to]) { if(visited[e.to] == 0) { queueBuffer[tail++] = e.to; if(tail == N) tail = 0; } else if(visited[e.to] == 2) { if(--head == -1) head += N; queueBuffer[head] = e.to; } visited[e.to] = 1; prevEdge[e.to] = idx; prevNode[e.to] = u; distArray[e.to] = nd; } } } return visited[sink] != 0; } struct P { int node, priority; P(int n, int p) : node(n), priority(p) {} bool operator<(const P& other) const { return priority > other.priority; } }; bool dijkstraWithPotential() { visited.assign(N, 0); distArray.assign(N, INF); prevNode.assign(N, 0); prevEdge.assign(N, 0); fill(distArray.begin(), distArray.end(), INF); distArray[source] = 0; priority_queue

pq; pq.push(P(source, 0)); while(!pq.empty()) { P current = pq.top(); pq.pop(); while(distArray[current.node] < current.priority) { if(pq.empty()) return false; current = pq.top(); pq.pop(); } visited[current.node] = 2; for(int i = 0; i < edgeMatrix[current.node].size(); i++) { Edge& e = edgeMatrix[current.node][i]; if(e.cap == 0) continue; int reducedCost = e.cost + distArray[current.node] - distArray[e.to]; int newDist = current.priority + reducedCost; if(newDist < distArray[e.to]) { if(visited[e.to] == 2) return false; pq.push(P(e.to, newDist)); distArray[e.to] = newDist; prevNode[e.to] = current.node; prevEdge[e.to] = i; visited[e.to] = 1; } } } return visited[sink] != 0; } int augmentFlow() { int pathFlow = INF; int node = sink; while(node != source) { int parent = prevNode[node], idx = prevEdge[node]; pathFlow = min(pathFlow, edgeMatrix[parent][idx].cap); node = parent; } node = sink; while(node != source) { int parent = prevNode[node], idx = prevEdge[node]; edgeMatrix[parent][idx].cap -= pathFlow; edgeMatrix[node][edgeMatrix[parent][idx].rev].cap += pathFlow; node = parent; } flow += pathFlow; return pathFlow; } void runAlgorithm() { initializePotential(); while(performSPFA()) { if(distArray[sink] >= INF - 1) break; totalCost += (long long)distArray[sink] * augmentFlow(); } } void runAlgorithmWithPotential() { initializePotential(); while(dijkstraWithPotential()) { long long reducedCost = distArray[sink] + (long long)distArray[sink] - distArray[source]; if(reducedCost >= INF) break; totalCost += reducedCost * augmentFlow(); for(int i = 0; i < N; i++) { if(visited[i] != 0) { potential[i] += distArray[i] - distArray[source]; } } } } int getFlow() { return flow; } long long getTotalCost() { return totalCost; } }; void run(int test, istream& in, ostream& out) { int n, m, k, c, d; in >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d; int maxLevels = n + k; int sinkNode = n * maxLevels + 1; MinCostFlow network(sinkNode + 1, 0, sinkNode); vector freq(n + 1, 0), positions(k + 1); for(int i = 1; i <= k; i++) { in >> positions[i]; freq[positions[i]]++; } for(int i = 1; i <= n; i++) { if(freq[i] > 0) network.addEdge(0, i, freq[i], 0); } for(int i = 2; i <= n; i++) { for(int level = 0; level < maxLevels - 1; level++) { network.addEdge(level * n + i, (level + 1) * n + i, k, c); } } for(int i = 1; i <= m; i++) { int u, v; in >> u >> v; for(int level = 0; level < maxLevels - 1; level++) { for(int p = 1; p <= k; p++) { if(u != 1) network.addEdge(level * n + u, (level + 1) * n + v, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c); if(v != 1) network.addEdge(level * n + v, (level + 1) * n + u, 1, d * (2 * p - 1) + c); } } } for(int level = 1; level < maxLevels; level++) { network.addEdge(level * n + 1, sinkNode, k, 0); } network.packEdges(); network.runAlgorithmWithPotential(); if(network.getFlow() != k) out << "BUG" << endl; else out << network.getTotalCost() << endl; } }; }; int main() { G instance; instance.begin(); return 0; } 0.95
